description: This file defines a CalendarEventBuilder class with methods to construct and populate calendar event objects, including static methods to create instances from booking data, and functions to build person objects from user and attendee data. It manages event details, metadata, responses, team info, and external references.

classes.name: CalendarEventBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing CalendarEvent objects with methods to set various event properties, including static methods to create instances from booking data.

methods.name: fromBooking
methods.description: Creates a CalendarEventBuilder instance from a booking object, populating event details, attendees, responses, team info, and external references.

methods.name: withBasicDetails
methods.description: Sets basic event details such as title, start/end time, and additional notes.

methods.name: withMetadataAndResponses
methods.description: Sets additional notes, custom inputs, responses, and user field responses.

methods.name: withLocation
methods.description: Sets event location and conference credentials.

methods.name: withConfirmation
methods.description: Sets confirmation requirements and default status.

methods.name: withPlatformVariables
methods.description: Sets platform-specific URLs and client ID.

methods.name: withOneTimePassword
methods.description: Sets a one-time password for the event.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Validates and returns the constructed CalendarEvent object or null if required fields are missing.
